category_edits.rationale: Double maximum history length from 128 to 256 across all four datasets to capture longer-term recurring preferences. Existing sampling, validation, positional-table sizing, checkpoint metadata, and generated predictor already use MAXLEN or its saved metadata, ensuring consistent chronological truncation and causal masking without other modeling changes.

response.change_summary: Increase SASRec context length to 256 through the TPE binding; preserve the backbone, loss, optimizer, seeds, epoch cap, and one-model-per-category routing.
